messages:
vivian (sec): FYI - during the nightly KMS rollover we observed a failure when signing multi-arch indexes for a small set of base images. Verifier rejects the arm64 index. Not an outage but needs tight coordination before we re-sign anything.

lee (infra): caught this in the morning alerts. Staging show: `cosign verify: manifest digest mismatch (platform arm64)` and `manifest list: platform entry missing` in some registries. Filed INC-4734.

jun (runtime): did we tighten KMS IAM last week? I recall changing the signer SA to only allow asymmetricSign. Could remote signing plugin need additional permissions to fetch metadata?

vivian (sec): possible. We should avoid mass rebuilds. Plan: (1) triage whether signing failed or ingestion/manifest-tool rearranged entries, (2) backup all manifests/signatures, (3) if only indexes need re-assembly, reindex + reattach signatures instead of rebuilding.

lee (infra): repro steps in staging: sign amd64 blob succeeds, arm64 fails at `build manifest list` step. Root cause: our manifest-tool image was moved to v1.1 which changed ordering semantics. Cosign expects canonical ordering when attaching signatures, and the re-ordered list caused digest mismatch after key rotation (timestamps differ). Pinning manifest-tool to v1.0.8 fixes it.

paul (oncall): ops notes: create scoped role `roles/cloudkms.signerLimited` with only `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign` and bind to `image-signer-prod@redwood`. No storage/registry perms. Also enable audit sink `sinks/img-signer` exporting to `gs://redwood-audit/signer/2026/` with retention locked.

build-bot: PR created: github.com/redwood-infra/image-signer/pull/47 - pins manifest-tool and adds cosign preflight.

vivian (sec): approve the scoped role. Also: we must copy current signatures and manifest lists to s3://redwood-image-audit/pre-rotate/ as immutable objects before touching anything. Retention 2y. Capture COSIGN_SIGNATURE metadata too.

jun (runtime): verifier change: add a short-lived flag `verifier.allow_reordered_index=true` (24h) behind canary (10% pods). It will accept manifest lists as long as mediaType matches `application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json` and platform entries present. Telemetry tag `reindex.audit_id` will be emitted for each accepted exception.

lee (infra): infra will build a hotfix runner with `manifest-tool:v1.0.8` and cosign 2.0.3. Job will: pull platform images, sign platform-specific blobs, construct a canonical index locally, attach signatures, upload index. Adding a preflight check: `cosign version && manifest-tool version` and `cosign verify sample-artifact` before proceeding.

paul (oncall): rollback playbook if verifier mishandles live traffic: 
```
# revert verifier flag and restart
kubectl set env deployment/verifier FEATURES=default -n security
kubectl rollout restart deployment/verifier -n security
# revoke temp IAM binding
gcloud iam service-accounts remove-iam-policy-binding image-signer-prod@redwood --member="serviceAccount:image-signer-prod@redwood" --role=roles/cloudkms.signerLimited
```

vivian (sec): also require trivy quick-scan and SBOM-diff on every reindexed image. If any layer digest differs from pre-rotate backups, halt the operation and escalate.

jun (runtime): will add an SBOM snapshot step and emit `sbom.diff_ok=true` to auditpipe. Also add a signed event for each manifest attach that goes to the audit sink.

lee (infra): staging run succeeded after pinning manifest-tool. Preflight logs: `cosign version 2.0.3`, `manifest-tool v1.0.8`, KMS asymmetricSign OK. Posting logs in PR.

build-bot: created issue link INC-4734 -> PR-47.

vivian (sec): schedule window: 2026-04-10T02:00:00Z for 60m. We'll run on canary repos first, backup all artifacts to s3://redwood-image-backups/multiarch-pre-rotate/, then proceed. Send security-cc when window is live.

paul (oncall): noted. I'll coordinate runbook and have oncall standby. Tag me on failures. :mag:

vivian (sec): thanks team. Keep updates here only. If anything blocks, escalate to security and oncall immediately. :lock:
